ocf_import.title: Import local OCF credential
ocf_import.description: Paste the complete contents of your q800f.ocf-credential.json backup. The soundbar identity and credential are verified before saving. Local storage uses restricted file permissions, not encryption. Keep an encrypted external backup; never send the credential to support. A successful import selects Hybrid Local + OCF for this entry.
